fact: Midi Madagasikara says Malagasy customs presented results obtained through its Enhanced Risk Assessment (ERA) smart targeting system at an IMF panel.
Midi Madagasikara says the customs data and AI centre CEDIA, launched in May 2025, automates anomaly detection and refines risk-targeting tools.
Madagascar's judicial authorities are evaluating AI tools for judicial support functions, announced 2 June 2026.
Newsmada says Madagascar's Customs has used AI since 2022 to analyse data, strengthen controls and anticipate risks.
system: Customs AI data analysis and risk

fact: Madagascar's customs directorate says it launched on 7 October 2025 the generative-AI agent SVO, which automatically analyses invoices and detects manipulations, inconsistencies and false invoices to strengthen the fight against fraud.

Madagascar's Customs Directorate launched the pilot phase of a Korean-customs-financed project in which ERA (Enhanced Risk Management), an automated AI risk system, will be integrated into the Sydonia World clearance platform.

The Ministry of Economy and Finance says the customs directorate, with the Korea Customs Service, launched a project on 4 December 2024 that creates an Enhanced Risk Management tool using AI, with scores indexed to declarations on Sydonia World, full deployment expected in 2026.

Madagascar's customs director general told an IMF panel on 27 March 2025 that the AI-based Enhanced Risk Assessment tool, with a data warehouse operational since late 2024, analyses millions of Sydonia records, with automated controls cutting clearance times and predictive analysis strengthening the fight against fraud.
